value.rationale: Replace the brittle phrase-specific compiler with a source-general clause compiler. It resolves representative definitions, preserves own versus affiliate-controlled recipients, treats coordinated representatives as disclosure actors rather than recipients, compiles embedded recipient exceptions, binds disposal actions to their actual triggers, preserves OR/AND and written-authorization asymmetry, and separates post-disposal retention from ordinary no-copy or survival language.
source_functions:
def ft_group_clause(valid,index):
    uid,text=valid[index]
    support=[uid]
    group=text
    low=text.lower()
    if index>0:
        puid,ptext=valid[index-1]
        plow=ptext.lower()
        opener=(ptext.rstrip().endswith(':') or 'shall, upon request' in plow or 'upon written demand' in plow or 'upon termination' in plow)
        if opener and ('return' not in plow and 'destroy' not in plow and 'delete' not in plow and 'erase' not in plow):
            group=ptext+' '+group
            support=[puid,uid]
    skip=0
    if index+1<len(valid):
        nuid,ntext=valid[index+1]
        nlow=ntext.lower()
        connected=(text.rstrip().endswith('; and') or text.rstrip().endswith(' and') or text.rstrip().endswith(':'))
        next_action=('return' in nlow or 'destroy' in nlow or 'delete' in nlow or 'erase' in nlow)
        if connected and next_action:
            group=group+' '+ntext
            support.append(nuid)
            skip=1
    return [group,support,skip]
